title: New AI-powered code assistant launched
content: A new open source AI coding assistant using large language models has been released on GitHub. It supports multiple programming languages and integrates with popular IDEs.

title: Show HN: I built a quantum computing simulator in Rust
content: After months of work, I'm releasing my quantum computing simulator written in Rust. It can simulate up to 30 qubits on consumer hardware.

title: Blockchain-based supply chain platform raises $50M
content: A startup building a blockchain platform for supply chain transparency has raised $50 million in Series B funding. The platform uses smart contracts to automate verification.

title: Machine learning framework for drug discovery
content: A new machine learning framework designed specifically for drug discovery and molecular modeling. Features include graph neural networks and molecular dynamics simulation.

title: Edge computing IoT platform hits 1M devices
content: An edge computing platform for IoT devices has reached 1 million connected devices. The platform provides real-time analytics and device management at the edge.

title: Cybersecurity startup detects zero-day vulnerabilities with ML
content: A cybersecurity startup has developed a machine learning system that can detect zero-day vulnerabilities by analyzing code patterns and network behavior anomalies.

title: Serverless framework for cloud-native applications
content: A lightweight serverless framework for building and deploying cloud-native applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Supports TypeScript and Go runtimes.

title: Fintech app using AI for personal finance management
content: A new fintech application uses artificial intelligence to help users manage personal finances, track spending patterns, and provide investment recommendations.
